reviews.text: Incredibly fun game with a massive amount of options and customization

If you're interested by the idea and videos, it's a steal at $1. There is an insane amount of customization. The only downside is that it's REALLY difficult to learn to play well! Think of Toribash meets Half Sword in a way. I spent an hour and a half swinging my sword around like crazy and had a great time.
Fun melee combat simulator: It has jank, but its still good despite that
it's janky but fun, potential is there. please polish and bugfix this

A janky half-sword with SOUL, has an amazing amount of customization and content, a singleplayer-rouge like mode, two story modes, and an arcade mode. At the moment joining a friends lobby is a bit difficult, but once it works its a blast!
The best jankiest game of all time

It's a fun game! Janky, but in a good way. Personally, I like this as a way to mess around with some friends, but there is a lot more there too if that's your thing. Normally, reviews say wait for a sale, but this game is so cheap for all the content it has! It's so cheap that you can buy copies for your friends to play with you, and it's still cheaper than a normal game. I can tell the devs care about their game, as I find updates pending every day, lol

Fun game to play when you have a few minutes. I enjoy the weapon and class variety. The skills are cool, and the game has that little buggy charm to it that makes it funny instead of irritating. Overall a pretty fun game and it runs great!
What really stands out is how much content is packed into one game. Campaigns, roguelike runs, online battles, sports modes, custom classes, and enough settings to keep experimenting for hours.
A physics-driven arena fighter packed with knights, sci-fi warriors, and wildly different classes. Campaigns, online battles, and creative modes give this far more depth than expected for the genre.
Blending medieval duels, futuristic combat, and playful physics, this arena brawler stands out through variety. Few games offer so ways to fight, compete, experiment, and stay entertained for hours.
More than a simple multiplayer fighter, this combines physics-based combat with campaigns, roguelike challenges, and extensive customization. There is always something new and worthwhile to explore.
Отличный физический экшен, который превращает обычные аренные бои в настоящее шоу. Рыцари, космические бойцы, десятки классов и множество режимов не дают заскучать ни на минуту. Очень залипательно.
Это аренный экшен, где соревновательные матчи превращаются в физический хаос. Побеждает не только скилл, но и умение адаптироваться к непредсказуемым столкновениям и внезапным игровым моментам .
